e.uyan_evlat_sis_bu: Wake up son! The fog came again tonight. I am Fenerci Yusuf — I have been lighting this lighthouse for forty years.
e.feneri_yak_kristal_cikar: Light the Lighthouse, get crystals, feed people. If the light goes out, the fog swallows everything.
e.ada_nefes_aliyor_ama: The island is breathing. But on the islands on the horizon, people are still trapped in the fog.

e.derinlerden_yukselen_sis_daha: The fog rising from the depths is darker than I have ever seen before...
